metadata.overview: Controls Bitmain Antminer miners running stock firmware through the HTTP CGI web API on port 80 with HTTP Digest authentication (factory default credentials root/root; override username and password in the device config). Compatibility is determined by firmware API capabilities reported by get_adjustment_params.cgi rather than a hard-coded model allowlist. Operations affect physical hardware — prioritize thermal safety.

telemetry.name: hashrate_rt
telemetry.description: Real-time hashrate (5-second window).

telemetry.name: hashrate_avg
telemetry.description: Average hashrate since startup.

telemetry.name: hashrate_ideal
telemetry.description: Ideal (nominal) hashrate. A persistent gap versus hashrate_rt indicates degraded hashboards or thermal throttling.

telemetry.name: power
telemetry.description: Current power draw in watts.

telemetry.name: efficiency
telemetry.description: Power efficiency (firmware reports J/TH, numerically identical to W/TH).

telemetry.name: temperature
telemetry.description: Maximum chip temperature across all hashboards. Sustained values above the firmware chip-temp threshold (default 95C) trigger protection.

telemetry.name: ambient_temp
telemetry.description: Ambient (inlet) temperature reported by the firmware; null when the firmware does not report an inlet sensor.

telemetry.name: fans
telemetry.description: Fan speeds as an array of { index, rpm }. A fan speed of 0 on a running miner is a mechanical failure — do not raise power until resolved.

telemetry.name: status
telemetry.description: Device status: error, sleeping, mining or not_mining. error means active warnings or a failing summary section.

telemetry.name: uptime
telemetry.description: Seconds since the last controller boot.

telemetry.name: power_mode
telemetry.description: Current power mode: normal, sleep, high or low, mapped from bitmain-work-mode. high/low are only supported when the firmware reports HEM/LEM capability.

telemetry.name: safe_mode
telemetry.description: True when the firmware has entered thermal-protection safe mode (throttled or stopped hashing).

telemetry.name: accepted_shares
telemetry.description: Accepted shares summed across all pools.

telemetry.name: rejected_shares
telemetry.description: Rejected shares summed across all pools. A rising rejection rate indicates pool or network problems.

telemetry.name: pool_url
telemetry.description: URL of the first alive pool, or the first configured pool when none is alive.

telemetry.name: pools
telemetry.description: Configured pools with runtime status and share counters. Pool passwords are never included.

telemetry.name: hashboards
telemetry.description: Per-hashboard frequency, ideal/real hashrate, ASIC status and counts, per-sensor temperature arrays, hardware errors and serial number.

telemetry.name: errors
telemetry.description: Active device warnings from warning.cgi plus failing summary status sections, each with code, cause and suggestion. An empty array means no active error.

telemetry.name: device_info
telemetry.description: Miner identity and network information: model, serial number, MAC, hostname, IP configuration and firmware type.

telemetry.name: firmware_info
telemetry.description: Firmware and platform information: miner type, subtype, firmware version, compile time and API version.

telemetry.name: miner_stats
telemetry.description: Normalized summary and stats objects as returned by summary.cgi and stats.cgi. Values are cached briefly by the device client to avoid duplicate device requests.

telemetry.name: snap
telemetry.description: Full structured snapshot (stats + config) aggregating every telemetry source with an error fallback.

commands.name: reboot
commands.description: Restarts the miner controller. Takes 2-3 minutes to resume hashing.
commands.constraints: Do not call more than once per 5 minutes. The cooldown is consumed by every attempt, including timed-out ones, because the device may have accepted the command.

commands.name: setLED
commands.description: Toggle the physical locate LED. A enabled LED automatically returns to off after 2 minutes.

commands.name: setPowerMode
commands.description: Changes the power mode (bitmain-work-mode): normal, sleep, high (HEM) or low (LEM).
commands.constraints: high and low require the firmware to report HEM/LEM support through get_adjustment_params.cgi. Do not select a higher-power mode unless cooling is operational. The write is a full read-modify-write of the miner config, so previously configured pools are preserved. A mode change restarts cminer: the new mode takes tens of seconds to show in telemetry, and power/efficiency read 0 for the first few minutes after the restart — do not treat that as a fault or alert on it.

commands.name: setHashratePercent
commands.constraints: The supported range is read from get_adjustment_params.cgi (typically 50-110). Verify cooling before increasing power.

commands.name: setUserIpSuffix
commands.description: Toggles appending the miner IP as a worker-name suffix (bitmain-user-ip-cat): pool worker names become <user>.<ip with dots replaced by X>, e.g. worker.192X168X1X99.
commands.constraints: Takes effect when cminer reloads the config. The write is a full read-modify-write of the miner config, so previously configured pools are preserved. Turning it off does not remove suffixes already registered at the pool.

commands.name: setupPools
commands.description: Configure mining pools (up to 3 slots). The pools parameter is an array of 1-3 pool objects (url, user, pass); the worker's configured pools are used when none are passed.
commands.constraints: Changes active mining destinations. The write preserves unused pool slots, and a written slot keeps its existing pool password unless a pass is supplied. A timeout has an unknown physical outcome and must not be retried automatically.

commands.name: setNetwork
commands.description: Configure DHCP or a static IPv4 address. Pass network.dhcp=true for DHCP, or network.dhcp=false with ip, netmask, gateway and dns fields for static addressing.
commands.constraints: The miner reboots and the current connection drops after this command. Preserve the old address and verify reachability at the new address. A timeout or connection reset has an unknown physical outcome and must not be retried automatically.

commands.name: downloadLogs
commands.description: Package and download the miner diagnostic logs as a Base64-encoded .tar archive with size and SHA-256 metadata. The dates parameter is an array of log date strings (e.g. ["/2026-09/22"]); defaults to the latest available log date.
commands.constraints: Log archives may be large. Store or decode the returned data promptly and avoid concurrent downloads from the same miner.

commands.name: updateFirmware
commands.description: Verify a Base64-encoded firmware image and upload it to the miner (configuration is preserved). Combined (N-in-1) firmware containers that bundle one image per control-board type are detected automatically and only the slice matching this miner's model and control board is uploaded.
commands.constraints: Firmware updates reboot the controller and can render the miner unreachable. The firmware object must include filename, encoding=base64, size, sha256 and data and must not exceed 64 MiB. The upload is sent once and is never retried; a timeout or disconnect after transmission has an unknown physical outcome.

troubleshooting: If alert.overheat, verify fan speeds and ambient temperature. A fan speed of 0 is a mechanical failure — do not raise power until resolved.
If alert.hashrate_low, the miner may be tuning boards or warming up — wait 15 minutes before acting.
If alert.hashboard_error persists after a reboot, escalate to an operator.
If alert.pool_dead, check the pool URLs and network path; all pools Dead means the miner is mining nothing.
If status is OFFLINE, do not attempt reboot. Escalate to an operator.
After setNetwork, verify reachability at the new address before any further command; never retry the write automatically.

errors.ERR_DEVICE_CONFIG_INVALID: The device config is missing an address or has an invalid port.
errors.ERR_HTTP_TIMEOUT: The request exceeded its timeout. For writes the physical outcome is unknown — never retry automatically.
errors.ERR_HTTP_CONNECTION: The connection failed or was reset. For writes the physical outcome is unknown — never retry automatically.
errors.ERR_AUTH_FAILED: The miner rejected the digest credentials. Check username/password in the device config.
errors.ERR_API_RESPONSE_INVALID: The miner returned a non-JSON or unexpected response.
errors.ERR_API_STATUS_ERROR: The miner reported STATUS E for a telemetry request.
errors.ERR_COMMAND_FAILED: The command failed without a more specific error code.
errors.ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE: A command parameter has an invalid type.
errors.ERR_COMMAND_COOLDOWN: The command was issued before its declared cooldown elapsed.
errors.ERR_COMMAND_IN_PROGRESS: A command of this type is already running for the device.
errors.ERR_SET_LED_ENABLED_INVALID: The setLED enabled parameter is not a boolean.
errors.ERR_SET_USER_IP_SUFFIX_INVALID: The setUserIpSuffix enabled parameter is not a boolean.
errors.ERR_SET_POWER_MODE_INVALID: The power mode is not one of normal, sleep, high or low.
errors.ERR_POWER_MODE_NOT_SUPPORTED: The firmware does not support the requested power mode (high requires HEM, low requires LEM).
errors.ERR_HASHRATE_PCT_NOT_SUPPORTED: The firmware does not support hashrate percentage adjustment.
errors.ERR_HASHRATE_PCT_RANGE: The hashrate percentage is outside the range reported by the firmware.
errors.ERR_POOLS_INVALID: The pool list must contain 1-3 entries, each with a url and a user or worker_name.
errors.ERR_MINER_CONF_READ_FAILED: Reading the current miner config failed before the write.
errors.ERR_NETWORK_CONFIG_INVALID: The network parameter does not select DHCP or provide a static configuration.
errors.ERR_NETWORK_ADDRESS_INVALID: A static network address is not a valid IPv4 value.
errors.ERR_NETWORK_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The network write was transmitted but the result is unconfirmed — the miner may already be rebooting. Verify at the new address; never retry automatically.
errors.ERR_LOG_DATES_INVALID: No valid log dates were supplied or available.
errors.ERR_LOG_BACKUP_FAILED: The miner rejected the log backup request.
errors.ERR_LOG_DOWNLOAD_RESPONSE_INVALID: The log archive download returned an invalid response.
errors.ERR_LOG_DOWNLOAD_SIZE_INVALID: The log archive is empty or exceeds 64 MiB.
errors.ERR_LOG_DOWNLOAD_INCOMPLETE: The connection ended before the archive was fully received.
errors.ERR_LOG_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT: The log archive download timed out.
errors.ERR_LOG_DOWNLOAD_CONNECTION: The log archive download connection failed.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_PAYLOAD_INVALID: The firmware parameter is not an object.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_FILENAME_INVALID: The firmware filename must be a non-empty basename.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_ENCODING_INVALID: The firmware data is not canonical Base64.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_SIZE_INVALID: The firmware size is invalid, mismatched or exceeds 64 MiB.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_SHA256_INVALID: The firmware sha256 is not a 64-character hex digest.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_SHA256_MISMATCH: The firmware content does not match its declared sha256.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_UPDATE_FAILED: The miner rejected the firmware image.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_NO_MATCHING_IMAGE: The firmware is a combined (N-in-1) container with no image for this miner's model and control board.
errors.ERR_FIRMWARE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The firmware image was transmitted but the result is unconfirmed — verify the firmware version after the miner reconnects; never retry automatically.
